You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From ef8201f00afc6a96f700b6e8d0165f4df4527364 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: flambard-took <flambard@mangband.org>
Date: Thu, 6 Jun 2019 14:06:14 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] Address #1305, fix bug introduced in 09395629810a4b5f010b8e.

When MAX_MSG is increased an appropriate entry must be inserted
into angband_sound_name array, or the client will crash.
---
 src/client/c-tables.c | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/src/client/c-tables.c b/src/client/c-tables.c
index 332bf470..ac8bf034 100644
--- a/src/client/c-tables.c
+++ b/src/client/c-tables.c
@@ -494,6 +494,7 @@ cptr angband_sound_name[MSG_MAX] =
 	"player_spell",
 	"player_prayer",
 	"player_action",
+	"monster_action",
 };
 
 
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by an increase in the MAX_MSG constant without updating the angband_sound_name array to include a corresponding entry for the new maximum message type. This oversight led to a situation where the client attempted to access an uninitialized or non-existent entry in the array, resulting in a crash. The patch addresses this by adding the missing "monster_action" entry to the angband_sound_name array, ensuring that all message types are properly accounted for.
